J-09.name: Every top-up run leaves an append-only record of what it attempted
J-09.notes: STILL PARTIAL — SECOND CONSECUTIVE ITERATION, and for the SAME single clause. THE UNMET CLAUSE (docs/goal.md J-09 Acceptance, verbatim): 'a [NEW]-flagged demo-narrator walkthrough covers the top-up-run disclosure end to end.' Iteration 12 was dispatched with that clause as its ONLY target, but produced NO walkthrough artifact at all: the evaluator searched the whole tree — reports/phase-goal-desk-iter-12-demo.json does not exist, reports/demo/goal-desk-iter-12/ does not exist, and the browser-qa report says so itself ('The [NEW]-flagged demo-narrator walkthrough itself ... is explicitly the demo-narrator agent's own deliverable ... not produced by this agent', reports/phase-goal-desk-iter-12-ui-test-results.llm.md:171-173). ROOT CAUSE, ESTABLISHED FROM THE SESSION TRACE, NOT GUESSED (runs/goal-session-desk/trace/trace.jsonl): at LEAN depth the demo-narrator runs AFTER the evaluator (iter-10: goal-evaluator 09:44 then demo-narrator 09:59; iter-8 the same), whereas at FULL depth it runs BEFORE (iter-11: demo-narrator 13:18 then goal-evaluator 14:17; iter-9 the same). A journey whose only outstanding clause is a demo-narrator artifact is therefore structurally unscoreable in a lean iteration. WHAT THIS ITERATION DID DELIVER, opened by the evaluator: (a) UT-J-09-empty-topup-section.png — a real /desk render on a freshly seeded, genuinely empty scoped rig showing the 'TOP-UP RUNS' panel with the circle-slash icon and 'No top-up runs recorded yet.'; (b) UT-J-09-populated-topup-section.png — one image holding the 3-row run table (topup-2026-07-28-52e271eacc44 done 404/404, topup-2026-07-28-ab37e4005b08 cancelled 3/404, topup-2026-07-28-6b40a8029a75 done 404/404, each with universe-2026-07-25-49b33fa31680) plus 'LATEST RUN — 2026-07-28 · TOPUP-2026-07-28-6B40A8029A75', 'state: done  404 of 404 pairs attempted  0 reused · 403 fetched · 1 failed' and 'Failed pairs (1): AAPL 1h — no data for that window'. Both satisfy the two browser clauses of the Acceptance. ONE DISCLOSED DEVIATION, accepted (see assumptions.md): the two frames come from TWO different scoped roots (desk-iter12-scoped-qa on :3301 populated, desk-iter12-scoped-qa-empty on :3302 empty), not one root photographed before and after, because the dev's own order (seed -> record 3 runs -> boot frontend) closed the honest-empty window before any browser existed, and the append-only rail forbids deleting the real records to recreate it. All other clauses were proven in iter-11 and are unaffected: the product tree is byte-identical between the two iterations (git diff on apps/ empty), so iter-11's byte-identity spy over the real run_topup, its cancelled-run and interrupted-run proofs, its second-run-appends checksum proof and its SSOT/Data-Contract proof still describe today's code.
